zoe: Heads-up: quick release broadcast for next week. Please read and flag anything blocking.

zoe: TL;DR:
- Planned freeze: 2026-04-05 00:00 UTC -> 2026-04-07 06:00 UTC (stability window).
- Weekly changelog cutoff: 2026-04-04 18:00 UTC.
- New policy: canary windows shorter by default (30m -> 15m) for infra patches unless owner opts into extended verification.

carlos: Question: why shorten canaries? we just increased flags for model-serving last month.

zoe: Shorter canaries reduce blast radius for infra churn and speed up small fixes. For higher-risk changes (model rollouts, scheduling), opt into extended canary in the release config.

emma: Will this affect Dedicated tenant updates?

zoe: Dedicated tenants are exempt from the default change. Platform teams must request extended canary for Dedicated push. We'll notify tenant owners via the dedicated-notify flow.

release-bot: release-bot: freeze window recorded: 2026-04-05T00:00:00Z -> 2026-04-07T06:00:00Z 8 id: freeze-2167801234

ops: Runbook reminder: if you need an exception, open a release-exception ticket before 2026-04-04 12:00 UTC. Template: https://redwood.internal/triage/release-exception

carlos: Can we add a short note to the weekly changelog explaining the canary default change and the rationale? Execs asked for a one-paragraph justification.

zoe: Yep. Draft for changelog: "Policy update: default canary duration for infra patches shortened to 15 minutes to reduce exposure from iterative infra churn; owners can opt into longer windows for high-risk rollouts. Dedicated customers unaffected unless they opt in." Thoughts?

emma: Add a line about monitoring: require p99 and 5xx gating for the 15m window, else automatic revert.

release-czar: I'll include that language and also prepare an exec blurb for Friday sync. I'll post the changelog entry to the weekly digest once finalized. :white_check_mark:

zoe: Thanks all. If you have objections to the policy change DM me. Otherwise expect the freeze notice to go org-wide at T-48h. We'll keep this thread for any last-minute opt-ins or blockers.
